description: AFFECT FRAME RULES v0.2.0 (block 369000 design; block 370000 extension, prereg docs/research/psychology_affect/AFFECT_FRAME_V02_PREREG.md). Each fired emotion of core_emotions publishes one integer affect frame, an Observation of relations aff:<tag>:val_sign, aff:<tag>:val_level and aff:<tag>:ar_level, whose levels are LogQuantum base-2 log levels of the emotion's own magnitudes. The af_direction rule compares the single frames of two successive appraisals (follows edge). af_component_direction does the same per shared emotion tag, so mixed events get ComponentDirection nodes. af_grow_codebook adds a ShapeSignature for an sd-minted affect frame and bumps codebook_epoch, so the sd loop re-decodes against the grown codebook. af_project_affective_state writes the latest appraisal's frames onto the canonical AffectiveState as additive attrs. The codebook itself lives in the affect_frame_canonical seed. No Rust, no Python decision.
